items.reason: It makes the same null-config NPE claim in getLoginPredicate's BROKER_PUBLIC check. The added write-path consequences do not change the alleged cause.

It identifies the same accumulation of organization-specific searches in one realm/mode cache entry. Memory growth and replication payload size are additional consequences of that same caching design.
It repeats the claim that cache hits return models without organization-aware wrapping, despite getById already performing that wrapping.
